name: Timeline: score a song, sections, hold and GO
description: A synthetic 120 BPM track with a known structure (intro 8 bars, build 8, drop 16, breakdown 8, build 4, drop 8, outro 8) on the Song row; Score this song finds the tempo and the seven sections on their bars, names them, and lays down a look per section with an energy line. On the render core's real pixels the look changes at the section boundaries (the output's colour changes across each boundary, and a different look block is on each side). Then Drop 1 is set to Hold for GO: playing into its end stops the playhead there with the song, the picture stays up, GO carries on into the breakdown.

eval.true.js: (() => { const s = __show.show(); const want = [[0,16,'Intro'],[16,32,'Build 1'],[32,64,'Drop 1'],[64,80,'Breakdown'],[80,88,'Build 2'],[88,104,'Drop 2'],[104,120,'Outro']]; return s.sections.length === 7 && s.sections.every((x, i) => Math.abs(x.start - want[i][0]) < 0.25 && Math.abs(x.end - want[i][1]) < 0.25 && x.name === want[i][2]); })()
eval.true.label: seven sections on the song's bars (within a bar), named intro, build, drop, breakdown, build, drop, outro

steps.label: the draft: a tempo from the song, a look per section (drops cut on the beat, then every bar), one energy line on All looks

eval.true.js: (() => { const s = __show.show(); return Math.abs(s.tempo.segments[0].bpm - 120) < 0.5 && s.lookClips.length > 20 && s.lines.some((l) => l.target.scope === 'look' && l.target.id === '*' && l.key === 'look:intensity'); })()
eval.true.label: tempo 120, look blocks, energy line

steps.label: Intro → Build 1 at 16 s: the look changes on the output (real pixels, ±0.4 s)

eval.true.js: (() => { const L = __show.show().lookClips; const at = (t) => L.filter((c) => t >= c.startTime && t < c.startTime + c.duration).map((c) => c.lookId + '/' + c.paletteId).join(); return at(16-0.4) !== at(16+0.4); })()
eval.true.label: a different look block on each side

eval.true.js: (() => { const s = __show.show(); return s.isPlaying && Math.abs(s.currentTime - 64) < 0.01 && __show.g().showTimeline.sectionState().hold !== null; })()

eval.true.js: (() => { const s = __show.show(); return s.isPlaying && s.currentTime > 65 && s.currentTime < 67 && __show.g().showTimeline.sectionState().hold === null; })()
